Research question: Can raw measurements define an empirical defrost optimum?
Claim supported: Complete raw-data cycles yield auditable policy-conditional cost minima.
Method: Raw approximately 1-s water-side and electrical integration with fixed observed defrost ticket
Main result: 47 cycles had complete candidate domains; 37 had an interior minimum
Limitations: No counterfactual early-defrost ticket; future clean anchor used offline
Contradictions: Broad regret valleys weaken exact-time labels

Research question: How precisely is the optimum identified?
Claim supported: Pointwise regret is more defensible than one universal time window.
Main result: Near-optimal width varied strongly and low-regret sets could be disconnected

Research question: Can cost curves supervise RGB frames without leakage?
Claim supported: Pointwise cost regret can be joined to images and split by experiment.
Population/context: 105178 image metadata rows; 45 cost-valid cycles with images
Method: Timestamp interpolation of candidate regret and whole-experiment partition
Main result: 57213 images were eligible within candidate domains
Verification status: Verified by tests and source tables

Research question: Which initial RGB task and model are viable?
Claim supported: Excluding the 1% near-optimal set produced a stronger engineering baseline than three-class prediction.
Population/context: Local images from a subset of cycles
Method: Five models on shared sampled frames and experiment-level split
Main result: Binary RBF-SVM exceeded three-class logistic on validation balanced accuracy
Limitations: Only two validation cycles and one post-optimal validation cycle; local test was inspected

Research question: Does the visual signal transfer between validation experiments?
Claim supported: Compact RGB features retain a strong cross-experiment signal in the currently available validation experiments.
Main result: Top-pair pooled images led the expanded validation comparison
Quantitative anchor: Balanced accuracy 0.953 for top_pair; 0.944 for all
Limitations: Only two experiments; camera differences lack uncertainty intervals
Contradictions: May reflect experiment/illumination effects rather than frost alone

Research question: Has energy-based optimal defrost timing been studied?
Claim supported: Energy-loss objectives can exhibit an optimal defrost initiation time.
Method: Minimum loss coefficient in nominal output heating energy
Main result: Reported and modelled an optimal initiation point
Limitations: Full method comparison pending full-text audit

Claim supported: Image recognition can support on-demand defrost control and prospective field evaluation.
Method: CNN frost-state recognition linked to defrost control
Main result: Reported reduced defrost frequency/time/energy under its field protocol
Limitations: Label and split contract require full-text audit

Research question: How should repeated images be partitioned?
Claim supported: Images from one experimental unit must remain in one partition and uncertainty must be reported.
Main result: Explicitly recommends subject-level splits and confidence intervals
Limitations: Medical domain; principle transferred only at design level

Research question: Does RGB add information beyond cycle progression?
Claim supported: RGB must outperform a strong retrospective time-only control before visual decision value is claimed.
Population/context: All cost-valid imaged cycles after streamed extraction
Method: Identical leave-one-experiment-out folds for RGB, retrospective cycle time and RGB plus time; paired experiment-level bootstrap
Main result: Interim results vary by camera and remain incomplete
Limitations: Candidate-domain progress uses the future observed boundary and is diagnostic rather than deployable
Contradictions: High image accuracy may otherwise reflect temporal or illumination drift
